text:
incident-bot: Pager alert (sev2) — gpu-prefill OOM spike on pool-7. 13 container restarts in the last 5m. Model: open-llama-70b-16k. Region: us-west-2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-oom

sarah_oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Pulling logs and job traces now.

mike_infra: Logs show CUDA OOM during prefill phase for requests with very long contexts (>12k tokens). Node 7c3 exhibiting memory fragmentation + repeated restarts.

ben_runtime: Looks like large-context prefill allocs blow VRAM and existing KV cache eviction is insufficient. Quick mitigations: enable prefill_kv_eviction, cap max_prefill_tokens per-route, and enable coldmodel fallback for pool-7. That should drop peak committed memory.

sarah_oncall: How do we flip those flags quickly?

ben_runtime: Hacking the console API now — patch example:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/v1/pools/pool-7/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prefill_kv_eviction": true, "max_prefill_tokens": 4096, "enable_coldmodel_fallback": true}'
```
I'll apply and watch.

jordan_sre: I'm going to cordon node 7c3 and rotate pods off it to stop noisy restarts. Also applying ingress throttling for pool-7 (reduce prefill concurrency).

mike_infra: Throttling policy: set prefill_concurrency=2 and reduce batch_size to 1 for 70b routes. Command: `rctl apply --pool pool-7 --set prefill_concurrency=2,batch_size=1`

eva_support: FYI customer impact: ACME-Analytics (dedicated) reporting 503s and truncated responses since 14:02 PT. I'm drafting an incident message to them.

sarah_oncall: Statuspage: marking partial outage for "Large-context generation" in us-west-2. ETA: mitigations rolling in 10-15m.

ops-bot: Feature-flag update: prefill_kv_eviction=true, max_prefill_tokens=4096 applied to pool-7 by ben_runtime at 14:10 PT.

ben_runtime: Telemetry after flag flip: prefill OOMs down from 13 -> 2 in last 5m window. Also lowered default batch_size for 70b in pool-7. Continuing to monitor.

jordan_sre: Node 7c3 cordoned and draining. Rolling traffic to healthy nodes and spinning up a fresh instance to replace it.

sarah_oncall: Handoff to night rotation @mike_night — I'll leave detailed notes below. If OOMs spike again, escalate to infra lead and consider temporarily disabling 16k-context model on pool-7.

mike_night: Ack. Watching the dashboard and logs. I'll hold the rotation and alert if OOMs > 5/min.

eva_support: Sent ACME a proactive update: we identified prefill memory surge caused by very long-context jobs, applied throttles and fallbacks, saw immediate improvement. Support will follow up when stabilized. :white_check_mark:

sarah_oncall: Final notes: schedule postmortem if root cause is fragmentation not just load; consider longer term fixes: smarter prefill admission control, per-customer context caps, and garbage-collect KV cache on long prefixes. Adding incident to backlog.

ops-bot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" at 14:27 PT (restarts reduced, traffic routed away from affected node).

sarah_oncall: Leaving oncall — handoff complete. Good job team. :slightly_smiling_face:
